entries.text: *whisper*\nOh hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_01

entries.text:
*whisper*
I’m checking in on Atticus.\c
*whisper*
So keep your voice down, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_02

entries.text: Okeydokey
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_select_01

entries.text: *whisper whisper*
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_select_02

entries.text: *whisper*\n’Preciate it.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_03

entries.text: Hmmmmmm...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_01

entries.text: I must say, the academy emporium stocks some\nrather splendid wares.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_02

entries.text: I admit my expectations were far lower\nthan warranted.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_03

entries.text: Wow. He really seems to have taken a shine to\nthe school store...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_04

entries.text: Doesn’t seem like he’ll notice us anytime soon,\nso I guess there’s no point whispering.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_05

entries.text: You know, of all my Team Star friends, it’s Atticus\nI’m worried will have the most trouble fitting in...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_06

entries.text: Greetings, my good shopkeep.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_04

entries.text: I would very much like to acquire the limited-\nedition ninja garments released today.\c\nI believe you have five sets in stock, yes?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_05

entries.text: Ah... The ninja cosplay set, yes?
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_shop_01

entries.text: I’m sorry, dear, but someone bought the last two\nfrom us earlier. We’re completely sold out.
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_shop_02

entries.text: What?! This cannot be!!![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_06

entries.text: If I am unable to procure those garments, why...\nI... That will ruin everything![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_07

entries.text: It appears I have no choice but to track down\nthis rival patron of mine! And when I find them...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_08

entries.text: I shall fix them with my piercing gaze and beg on\nbended knee for the ninja garments I so crave![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_09

entries.text: Whaaaaaat?! Since WHEN was Atticus this\ngood-looking?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_07

entries.text: Wait, no, focus! If he starts begging some kid for\ntheir ninja outfit, people will think he’s a weirdo.\r\nWe should stop him, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_08

entries.text: Yeah, time for an intervention
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_select_03

entries.text: Let’s just see how this pans out
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_select_04

entries.text: Th-then that’s what we’ll do![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_09a

entries.text: Seriously? But...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_09b

entries.text: Oh, Don Atticus! Here you are!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_01

entries.text: My young compadre![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_10

entries.text: I...I must apologize.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_11

entries.text: About the garments I promised you so that we\nmight dress as ninja together...[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_12

entries.text: Oh yeah, I got us covered! I already bought two\nsets of that ninja cosplay stuff for us to wear!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_02

entries.text: ...I beg your pardon?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_13

entries.text: When I came here earlier, the shopkeeper lady\nwas putting them out on the shelves.\c\nSo I bought one for you and one for me!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_03

entries.text: You know how popular these outfits are...\nI was super lucky to be able to snag ’em!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_04

entries.text: Now c’mon! Let’s go play ninja outside!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_05

entries.text: Goodness me... What a happy turn of events![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_14

entries.text: I shall retrieve my shuriken from my quarters\nso that we might enjoy some target practice![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_15

entries.text: Ooooooh! Awesome!
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_06

entries.text: I can also use my masterful stitchery to transform\nthy ninja garments into a sublime vision of poison!\r\nWhat say you?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_16

entries.text: Ummm... I’m good, thanks.
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_student_07

entries.text: Ha ha ha! The insolence of this one![VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_doku_17

entries.text: Phew... Looks like he was able to wrap up this\nlittle escapade without making a scene.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_10

entries.text: But more importantly—Atticus has already made\na friend at school![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_11

entries.text: Kinda makes me feel bad that I thought I had to\nspy on him...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_12

entries.text: Anyway, I guess I’ll get going. Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: kizuna_botan_b_13
